note: TEST licensing key pair for development, tests and the smoke test only. It is public: anyone can sign licences with it, so a production build must set NEXT_PUBLIC_LICENSE_PUBLIC_KEY (and the billing Worker LICENSE_PRIVATE_JWK) to a key pair generated with scripts/billing-keygen.mjs and kept secret.
algorithm: ES256 (ECDSA P-256, SHA-256; JWS raw r||s signatures as WebCrypto produces them)
